decisionDocument:
## Existing context

The goal is non-trivial: it adds a new concrete provider, runtime, models, application runner, public exports, and package subpath metadata. These are cross-cutting provider-surface decisions and should be aligned up front.

This repo is a strict TypeScript package built with `tsup`; `npm run build` is the validation path. No test runner is configured. Source uses tabs, PascalCase class/type names, kebab-case filenames, and path aliases `@domain/*`, `@app/*`, and `@infra/*`.

OpenAI provider conventions to mirror:
- Runtime class lives under `src/infrastructure/providers/openai/runtime/openai-responses.ts` and implements `ModelRuntime`.
- Model classes live under `src/infrastructure/providers/openai/models/*.ts`, implement `GenerativeModel`, `ToolCallingCapability`, and `ReasoningEffort<...>`, and own mutable `Tool[]`.
- Provider-specific reasoning helper lives at `src/infrastructure/providers/openai/reasoning-effort.ts`.
- Application runner lives at `src/application/openai-inference-runner.ts`, implements `InferenceRunner`, constructs its runtime internally, and yields response context items.
- Public imports are centralized in `src/index.ts`.

Important existing domain shapes:
- `GenerativeModel` currently extends `ReasoningEffort<string>` and `ToolCallingCapability`, so Anthropic model classes must expose `setReasoningEffort`, `getReasoningEffort`, `setTools`, and `getTools` even if a specific provider capability is limited.
- `TokenUsage` constructor is `new TokenUsage(inputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens, InputTokenDetails, OutputTokenDetails)`.
- `InputTokenDetails` contains only `cached_tokens`; map Anthropic cache creation + cache read tokens into this single field.
- `OutputTokenDetails` contains only `reasoning_tokens`; Anthropic does not expose a directly equivalent value in normal usage, so default to `0`.
- `FunctionCallItem.rehydrate` expects `{ callId, name, args }`, where `args` is a string.
- `ModelMessageItem.rehydrate` expects `{ text }`.
- `ReasoningItem.rehydrate` expects `{ content, encryptedContent, summary }`, but its constructor stores `content` as `InputText | undefined`; use existing item-content classes rather than introducing new domain fields.

## File paths

New files to create:
- `src/infrastructure/providers/anthropic/runtime/anthropic-messages.ts`
- `src/infrastructure/providers/anthropic/models/claude-4-7-opus.ts`
- `src/infrastructure/providers/anthropic/models/claude-4-6-sonnet.ts`
- `src/infrastructure/providers/anthropic/models/claude-4-5-haiku.ts`
- `src/infrastructure/providers/anthropic/reasoning-effort.ts`
- `src/application/anthropic-inference-runner.ts`

Existing files to modify:
- `src/index.ts`
- `package.json`

Do not modify:
- Any file under `src/infrastructure/providers/openai/`.
- Any domain interface or shared domain class.

## API contracts

No Mozaik public interface changes are allowed. Implement against existing interfaces only.

### `AnthropicMessages`

File: `src/infrastructure/providers/anthropic/runtime/anthropic-messages.ts`

Class:
```ts
export class AnthropicMessages implements ModelRuntime
```

Constructor:
```ts
constructor()
```

Behavior:
- Construct `private readonly client: Anthropic` using the SDK default constructor:
  ```ts
  import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk"
  this.client = new Anthropic()
  ```
- Implement:
  ```ts
  async infer(inferenceRequest: InferenceRequest): Promise<InferenceResponse>
  ```
- Call Anthropic Messages API:
  ```ts
  await this.client.messages.create(request)
  ```

Request shape to Anthropic:
```ts
{
	model: inferenceRequest.model.specification.name,
	max_tokens: inferenceRequest.model.specification.maxOutputTokens,
	messages: AnthropicMessageParam[],
	system?: string,
	tools?: AnthropicToolParam[],
	thinking?: { type: "enabled"; budget_tokens: number }
}
```

Context mapping rules:
- `SystemMessageItem` (`role === "system"`) must not be placed in `messages`; concatenate system message text into the top-level `system` string. If multiple system items exist, join with `"\n\n"`.
- `UserMessageItem` maps to:
  ```ts
  { role: "user", content: [{ type: "text", text }] }
  ```
- `DeveloperMessageItem` has no Anthropic role equivalent. Treat it like additional system instruction text and append to top-level `system`, joined with `"\n\n"`.
- `ModelMessageItem` maps to:
  ```ts
  { role: "assistant", content: [{ type: "text", text }] }
  ```
- `FunctionCallItem` maps to an assistant `tool_use` content block:
  ```ts
  {
  	role: "assistant",
  	content: [{
  		type: "tool_use",
  		id: item.callId,
  		name: item.name,
  		input: JSON.parse(item.args)
  	}]
  }
  ```
  If `item.args` is not valid JSON, use the raw string as `input` only if accepted by SDK types is impractical; otherwise use `{ value: item.args }`. Prefer a private helper `parseJsonObjectOrFallback`.
- `FunctionCallOutputItem` maps to a user `tool_result` content block:
  ```ts
  {
  	role: "user",
  	content: [{
  		type: "tool_result",
  		tool_use_id: item.callId,
  		content: item.output.toJSON().text
  	}]
  }
  ```
- `ReasoningItem` should not be sent back unless it is safely representable by Anthropic SDK types. For this run, omit reasoning items from request history.

Response mapping rules:
- For each `response.content` block:
  - `type === "text"` → `ModelMessageItem.rehydrate({ text: block.text })`
  - `type === "tool_use"` → `FunctionCallItem.rehydrate({ callId: block.id, name: block.name, args: JSON.stringify(block.input ?? {}) })`
  - `type === "thinking"` → `ReasoningItem.rehydrate(...)`
- Preserve output order from `response.content`.
- Filter/skip unsupported response block types rather than returning `undefined` entries.

Reasoning response mapping:
- For Anthropic extended thinking block text, create a `ReasoningItem`.
- Use existing `InputText` and `SummaryText` types from `src/domain/model-context/context-item/item-content`.
- Exact call:
  ```ts
  ReasoningItem.rehydrate({
  	content: block.thinking ? InputText.rehydrate({ text: block.thinking }) : undefined,
  	encryptedContent: "signature" in block ? block.signature : undefined,
  	summary: [],
  })
  ```
- Do not add new reasoning fields to the domain.

Token usage mapping:
- If `response.usage` is absent, return `undefined`.
- Otherwise:
  ```ts
  const inputTokens = response.usage.input_tokens
  const outputTokens = response.usage.output_tokens
  const cachedTokens =
  	(response.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens ?? 0) +
  	(response.usage.cache_read_input_tokens ?? 0)
  const totalTokens = inputTokens + outputTokens
  new TokenUsage(
  	inputTokens,
  	outputTokens,
  	totalTokens,
  	new InputTokenDetails(cachedTokens),
  	new OutputTokenDetails(0),
  )
  ```

Tool mapping:
- Only include `tools` if `specification.supportFunctionCalling` is true and `model.getTools().length > 0`.
- Existing Mozaik `FunctionTool` maps to Anthropic tool definition:
  ```ts
  {
  	name: tool.name,
  	description: tool.description,
  	input_schema: tool.parameters,
  }
  ```
- Do not pass OpenAI-only fields such as `type: "function"` or `strict` to Anthropic.

Reasoning request mapping:
- Add Anthropic thinking only if `specification.supportReasoningEffort` is true and `model.getReasoningEffort()` is not `"none"`.
- Anthropic thinking requires a token budget, not OpenAI-style string effort. Use helper mapping:
  - `"low"` → `1024`
  - `"medium"` → `4096`
  - `"high"` → `8192`
  - `"none"` → no `thinking` field
- Set:
  ```ts
  thinking: { type: "enabled", budget_tokens: budget }
  ```
- If Anthropic SDK requires beta headers for thinking in this SDK version, do not introduce global config changes; keep implementation localized in `AnthropicMessages`.

## Frontend integration

Not applicable. This is a TypeScript library provider integration with no frontend code.

## Library/dependency choices

Use existing dependency:
- `@anthropic-ai/sdk` from `package.json`.

Do not add dependencies:
- Do not add another Anthropic client package.
- Do not add test libraries.
- Do not add schema/transformation libraries.

Use existing domain/application abstractions:
- `ModelRuntime`
- `InferenceRunner`
- `InferenceRequest`
- `InferenceResponse`
- `TokenUsage`
- `GenerativeModel`
- `ToolCallingCapability`
- `ReasoningEffort`

Do not change public domain interfaces.

## Naming conventions

Provider directory:
- Use `anthropic` as provider directory and package subpath segment.

Runtime:
- File: `src/infrastructure/providers/anthropic/runtime/anthropic-messages.ts`
- Class: `AnthropicMessages`

Application runner:
- File: `src/application/anthropic-inference-runner.ts`
- Class: `AnthropicInferenceRunner`
- Mirror `OpenAIInferenceRunner`; define local type:
  ```ts
  type InferenceItem = ReasoningItem | FunctionCallItem | ModelMessageItem
  ```
- The `signal?: AbortSignal` parameter remains in the signature for interface compatibility. It does not need to be passed through unless Anthropic SDK typing makes that straightforward.

Reasoning helper:
- File: `src/infrastructure/providers/anthropic/reasoning-effort.ts`
- Export:
  ```ts
  export type AnthropicReasoningEffortType = "high" | "medium" | "low" | "none"
  export class AnthropicReasoningEffort implements ReasoningEffort<AnthropicReasoningEffortType>
  ```
- Implement `setReasoningEffort` and `getReasoningEffort` like `OpenAIReasoningEffort`.
- Add exported helper:
  ```ts
  export function anthropicReasoningBudgetTokens(effort: AnthropicReasoningEffortType): number | undefined
  ```
  with mapping from API contract section.

Model classes:
- `src/infrastructure/providers/anthropic/models/claude-4-7-opus.ts`
  - Class: `Claude47Opus`
  - `specification.name`: use Anthropic literal model id for Claude Opus 4.7.
- `src/infrastructure/providers/anthropic/models/claude-4-6-sonnet.ts`
  - Class: `Claude46Sonnet`
  - `specification.name`: use Anthropic literal model id for Claude Sonnet 4.6.
- `src/infrastructure/providers/anthropic/models/claude-4-5-haiku.ts`
  - Class: `Claude45Haiku`
  - `specification.name`: use Anthropic literal model id for Claude Haiku 4.5.

Model implementation pattern:
```ts
export class Claude47Opus
	implements GenerativeModel, ReasoningEffort<AnthropicReasoningEffortType>, ToolCallingCapability
{
	readonly specification = {
		name: "...",
		supportReasoningEffort: true,
		defaultReasoningEffort: "none" as AnthropicReasoningEffortType,
		supportStreaming: false,
		contextWindowSize: 200_000,
		maxOutputTokens: 32_000,
		supportFunctionCalling: true,
	}

	private tools: Tool[] = []

	setTools(tools: Tool[]): void {
		this.tools = tools
	}

	getTools(): Tool[] {
		return this.tools
	}

	private readonly effort = new AnthropicReasoningEffort(this.specification.defaultReasoningEffort)

	setReasoningEffort(effort: AnthropicReasoningEffortType): void {
		this.effort.setReasoningEffort(effort)
	}

	getReasoningEffort(): AnthropicReasoningEffortType {
		return this.effort.getReasoningEffort()
	}
}
```

Use the same structure for all three model classes. Do not create an abstract base class unless necessary; mirroring OpenAI’s duplication is preferred for consistency.

Model identifier decision:
- Use Anthropic’s exact production model identifier strings current for these model names.
- Do not invent Mozaik aliases.
- The exported class names are Mozaik-friendly (`Claude47Opus`, `Claude46Sonnet`, `Claude45Haiku`), while `specification.name` is the Anthropic API literal.

Public export names:
- `AnthropicMessages`
- `AnthropicInferenceRunner`
- `Claude47Opus`
- `Claude46Sonnet`
- `Claude45Haiku`
- `AnthropicReasoningEffort`
- `AnthropicReasoningEffortType`

## Package/public-surface decisions

Modify `src/index.ts`:
- Add imports for:
  ```ts
  import { AnthropicMessages } from "@infra/providers/anthropic/runtime/anthropic-messages"
  import { AnthropicInferenceRunner } from "@app/anthropic-inference-runner"
  import { Claude47Opus } from "@infra/providers/anthropic/models/claude-4-7-opus"
  import { Claude46Sonnet } from "@infra/providers/anthropic/models/claude-4-6-sonnet"
  import { Claude45Haiku } from "@infra/providers/anthropic/models/claude-4-5-haiku"
  import {
  	AnthropicReasoningEffort,
  	AnthropicReasoningEffortType,
  } from "@infra/providers/anthropic/reasoning-effort"
  ```
- Add all of these to the existing export block.
- Keep OpenAI imports/exports unchanged.

Modify `package.json`:
- Add `typesVersions` subpath:
  ```json
  "providers/anthropic": [
  	"dist/providers/anthropic/index.d.ts"
  ]
  ```
- Keep `"files": ["dist"]`.
- Do not add dependencies.
- Do not change `tsup` config for this run.

Note: `import { AnthropicMessages, Claude47Opus } from "@mozaik-ai/core"` is satisfied by `src/index.ts` and the single bundle. The `typesVersions` addition is for parity with OpenAI’s forward-compatible provider subpath metadata.

## Migration / shipping notes

No DB migrations.

Production-safety and compatibility notes:
- Existing OpenAI code must remain untouched.
- Anthropic response content extraction must filter unsupported blocks to avoid `undefined` values in `InferenceResponse.contextItems`.
- `AnthropicMessages` should return `TokenUsage` whenever Anthropic includes `usage`; acceptance requires populated token usage for a one-shot inference.
- `AnthropicInferenceRunner` should intentionally mirror OpenAI behavior and yield only context items; it does not expose token usage because `InferenceRunner` currently has no token usage channel.
- Do not change `ModelRuntime`, `InferenceRunner`, `TokenUsage`, `GenerativeModel`, or any context item public shape.
